definition: the transfer of pollen from one flower to another so seeds and fruit can form
sentence: Bees help with pollination when they carry pollen from blossom to blossom.

definition: the sweet liquid inside flowers that bees collect to make honey
sentence: A honeybee drinks nectar from a clover flower in the meadow.

definition: a structure where a colony of bees lives and stores honey
sentence: Thousands of worker bees return to the hive each evening with nectar.

definition: a large group of bees that live and work together as one community
sentence: A healthy colony may contain tens of thousands of bees in summer.

definition: a chemical used to kill insects or other pests that can also harm bees
sentence: Some pesticides sprayed on crops can poison foraging honeybees.

definition: a community of living things interacting with each other and their environment
sentence: Bees are a key part of the farm ecosystem because they pollinate food crops.

definition: to make a plant able to produce seeds or fruit by bringing pollen to it (Canadian spelling)
sentence: When bees fertilise apple blossoms, the trees can grow crisp autumn fruit.

definition: the fine powder from flowers that bees carry and that plants need for reproduction
sentence: Yellow pollen stuck to the bee's legs as she crawled inside the bloom.

definition: a female bee that gathers food, builds comb, and cares for the hive (not the queen)
sentence: A worker bee may visit hundreds of flowers in a single foraging trip.

definition: the practice of farming, including growing crops and raising animals for food
sentence: Canadian agriculture depends on bees to pollinate blueberries, canola, and apples.
